meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会持续盯住一个 PR:反复检查评论、审查线程和 CI 结果,发现真实问题就修复并推送,直到检查通过、无可操作评论时才停止。
howto.when: 当你要求 babysit、monitor,或说持续检查 PR 的评论、审查和 CI 直到问题解决时触发。

say.text: 帮我 babysit 这个 PR,直到能合并
say.note: Claude 会开始轮询状态并处理问题

say.text: 持续盯着 review 线程,有未解决就修好
say.note: 会逐个核实并解决可处理的评论

say.text: 监控这个 PR 的 CI,有失败就查原因
say.note: 会等待检查完成并处理真实问题

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude keeps watching a pull request: it repeatedly checks comments, review threads and CI results, fixes real issues in commits, and pushes them, stopping only when checks pass and no actionable comments remain.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to babysit, monitor, or keep checking a PR's comments, reviews, and CI until actionable issues are resolved.

say_en.text: Babysit this PR until it can be merged.
say_en.note: Claude starts polling status and handling issues.

say_en.text: Keep watching the review threads and resolve any open ones.
say_en.note: It verifies and addresses actionable comments.

say_en.text: Monitor this PR's CI and investigate failures.
say_en.note: It waits for checks and handles real problems.
